Hi Irene / Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We’re ready to schedule the SOC 2 walk-through and a short pen-test kickoff to confirm scope. Our security team would like a single 60-minute session covering:
- SOC 2 controls mapping (high level)
- DPA topics and data flows
- Pen test scope and timing assumptions

Can you confirm what prep you need from us (evidence list / owner matrix)? I can share an internal index if that helps.

Attaching our internal preferred times in the next email. Looking for an ops bridge too if that’s standard for you.

Thanks,

Head of Security Programs
Chronicle Health

Matt / Leah — thanks, happy to run this.

High level ask from our side before the call:
- Evidence inventory (list of artifacts and owners) — minimal template attached.
- High-level list of vendors handling PHI or sensitive data (for routing).
- Any blackout dates for leadership (to keep it to 60min).

We can cover both SOC 2 + pen-test scoping in one session; we typically start with a 40-minute controls overview and finish with a 20-minute pen-test Q&A.

Available windows (ET) during the week you suggested:
- Tue Jun 23: 11:00–12:00, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Jun 24: 09:30–10:30, 16:00–17:00
- Thu Jun 25: 13:00–14:00

(PT equivalents included for clarity — e.g., Tue 11:00 ET = Tue 08:00 PT).

We’ll also set up a 15-minute ops bridge 20 minutes before the walkthrough to validate connectivity and access to any shared consoles. Jonas — can you confirm ops bridge availability? I’ll attach our preflight checklist and the evidence-template.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Product Security Manager
